items.title: Amazon Athena introduces system tables for query execution observability
items.summary: Amazon Athena now offers system tables: SQL-queryable, per-query execution metadata stored as Apache Iceberg in your own account. This post walks through what system tables are, how to turn them on, and how to use them for usage analysis, cost attribution, performance trends, audit, and capacity optimization without custom pipelines.
items.creator: Pathik Shah
